title: Assemble the Payment Batch
subtitle: Gather the day's approved invoices against the cutoff
scenario: It is 2:00 PM. The cutoff is 3:00 PM. Approved invoices need to be gathered into one payment batch the AP Manager can approve in a single action. Today that is one clean invoice - INV-58831, auto-approved at $1,220 - with nothing held in exceptions. Build the batch record.
input: Approved for payment: INV-58831 (V-1042, 1220.00), auto-approved. Exception queue: 0 held. Batch date: day-1. Payment cutoff: 3:00 PM. A batch gathers the approved invoices, counts them, and totals them so the run can be approved and released in one step.
instructions: Record the batch date and the payment cutoff.
Count the approved invoices in the batch and total their amounts.
Record how many invoices are held in exceptions (not in this batch).
Return one valid JSON object. Use numbers for the count and total.
copilotPrompt: Produce a payment-batch JSON record: batchDate, cutoff, invoiceCount, batchTotal, and heldCount. Include only approved invoices; count and total them; record how many are held in exceptions.
successMessage: Payment batch assembled. One approved invoice, $1,220.00 total, nothing held - ready for run approval.
editorHelper: Gather the approved invoices into one countable, totaled batch.

intro.heading: Before the run: gather what is approved

sections.title: One approval, many invoices
sections.body: A batch lets the AP Manager approve a whole day of payments in a single action instead of one by one. Today it holds one invoice, but the shape is the same at any volume.

sections.title: Only what is approved
sections.body: The batch includes auto-approved invoices and any exceptions a human resolved. Anything still in the exception queue is held out - heldCount records that it was consciously excluded, not lost.

sections.title: Count and total
sections.body: The invoice count and batch total are the control figures the run approval checks. They must recompute from the included invoices - one invoice at 1220.00 gives a count of 1 and a total of 1220.

sections.title: The cutoff is real
sections.body: The batch is assembled against the 3:00 PM cutoff. Anything approved after the cutoff waits for tomorrow's batch - a deadline the whole desk works toward.

takeaway.heading: Payment batch assembled
points: You gathered the day's approved invoices into one batch the AP Manager can approve in a single action.
The batch includes only approved invoices; heldCount records that nothing sat unresolved in exceptions.
The count (1) and total (1220) are control figures the run approval will re-check.
The batch is built against the real 3:00 PM cutoff, saved as payment-batch.json.
The workflow can now present a day of approved payments as one approvable, totaled batch.
